page.overview:
Who is Best Fitness Friends?

The Best Fitness Friends is the ultimate BFF form, and the final boss in Bowser Jr.'s Journey. It is fought in Bowser Castle.

The merged Best Fitness Friends monster becomes a lot more monstrous. He has white eyes that have no pupils and a red, yellow, and blue bow-tie, and his arms, legs, and hair are red, yellow, and blue, the colors of the unmerged trio. His body is black.
